titel: Click Joints Pro, videobeeld lange video 4-3l3MZZWPc (YouTube en Superhive, issue #94 stap 3)
rol: You design figures in Blender and want to 3D print them at home, ideally poseable with joints. You searched YouTube for a Blender add-on that turns a model into printable parts. You see these video thumbnails in the results and pick the add-on whose video you would watch first and most likely buy.
